title: Temperature conversion to Kelvin
description: Essential: Student correctly converts Celsius temperatures to Kelvin for both initial and final states.

title: Part 1 final pressure
description: Essential: Student obtains the correct numerical pressure for 37°C (approximately 1.085 × 10⁵ Pa).

title: Apply Charles's Law
description: Important: Student recognizes the volume is constant for part 1 and correctly applies p/T = constant.

title: Part 2 volume ratio
description: Essential: Student calculates the correct volume ratio (approximately 0.97).

title: Apply Boyle's Law
description: Important: Student recognizes the temperature is constant for part 2 and correctly applies pV = constant.

title: Using Celsius directly
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly uses Celsius temperatures in gas law calculations without converting to Kelvin.

title: Significant figures/units
description: Optional: Student presents answers with appropriate significant figures and includes correct units.
